diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with the incentre I and a blue circle centred at I that cuts BC at A1, A2, CA at B1, B2 and AB at C1, C2, forming a hexagon drawn in grey. Green dashed lines are the bisectors of angles B and C; the blue dashed segment B1C2 passes through I. The red segments A1B1 and A2C2 are parallel to the bisectors of angles B and C respectively.
